:::{#thm-rrd-switch-ref}

#### Switching the reference group in a relative risk difference

For nonzero probabilities $\pi_1$ and $\pi_2$,
the relative risk difference with the reference group switched is:

$$\xi(\pi_2,\pi_1) = \inv{\xi(\pi_1,\pi_2) + 1} - 1$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-change-ref-group, worked in @sol-change-ref-group.

:::
